snp2.12:10.3: _Kāmakāro_: “wish-granter”. Ordinary people have no spell or magic gem to grant them what they want.
snp2.12:10.4: _Saṅkheyyakāro_: “comprehensibility-granter”. _Saṅkheyya_ is “calculable, comprehensible”, not “after comprehension”. The Buddha has a gift for explaining things in a way that makes them comprehensible.
snp2.12:12.2: Text reads _anomavīra_ (“unrivalled hero”), but read _jānamanomavīriya_ (“one of unrivaled energy”) per [thag21.1:65.2](). The phrase parallels _anomapañña_ (“one of unrivaled wisdom”) and thus is likely to refer to a mental quality.
